theme: 3 terms on text size: the user setting, the named font role, and the custom font that follows it

terms.definition: A setting that lets users make text bigger or smaller in every app.
terms.example: Turn on Dynamic Type in Settings and check that nothing is cut off.

terms.definition: A named font role, such as body or title, that grows with the user's text size.
terms.example: Use a Text Style instead of a fixed font size.

terms.definition: A custom font that you scale with `UIFontMetrics`, so it follows the user's text size.
terms.example: Our brand font needs a Scaled Font to support larger text.

quizzes.question: What do you call a custom font that you scale with `UIFontMetrics` so it follows the user's text size?
In this code, which setting makes the label follow the user's text size?

video.title: Dynamic Type, Text Style & Scaled Font | Day 114
video.description:
Learn to explain how text grows with the user's size setting in iOS: Dynamic Type, Text Style & Scaled Font, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Dynamic Type - A setting that lets users make text bigger or smaller in every app.
Text Style - A named font role, such as body or title, that grows with the user's text size.
Scaled Font - A custom font that you scale with `UIFontMetrics`, so it follows the user's text size.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Dynamic Type - A setting that lets users make text bigger or smaller in every app.
한국어: 다이내믹 타입: 모든 앱의 글자 크기를 사용자가 바꾸는 설정

Text Style - A named font role, such as body or title, that grows with the user's text size.
한국어: 텍스트 스타일: 본문이나 제목처럼 이름 붙은 글꼴 역할

Scaled Font - A custom font that you scale with `UIFontMetrics`, so it follows the user's text size.
한국어: 스케일드 폰트: `UIFontMetrics`로 키워 사용자 글자 크기를 따르는 커스텀 글꼴

dialogue.title: The text is too small

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, a user says our text is too small.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you support Dynamic Type for the label?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did. But the font is fixed at 20.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is the problem. A fixed font cannot grow. Use a Text Style or a Scaled Font.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What is a Text Style again?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A named role, like body or title. It grows with Dynamic Type by itself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But we have a custom font.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then make a Scaled Font with `UIFontMetrics`, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see. The metrics use the body Text Style to scale the base font.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Now Dynamic Type works for the custom font too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let me test the largest size.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good idea. Check that the layout still fits.
Dynamic Type lets users choose their text size.
